objective: Determine the exact private-message sum-capacity C_sum of the half-skew binary skew-symmetric broadcast channel specified by the canonical problem.
terminalCondition: A validity-v4 accepted result establishes one exact value of C_sum by matching rigorous achievability and converse bounds, including every limiting, cardinality, and certification condition needed for the canonical channel.

workUnit.definition: One focused person-hour of research by a researcher qualified for the relevant work package, using the fixed conventional tool baseline named by this contract.
workUnit.toolBaseline: Public mathematical literature and standard non-autonomous research tools available as of 2026-08-25, including handwritten reasoning, symbolic algebra, numerical computation, interval arithmetic, proof assistants, and code execution on commodity research hardware; autonomous LLM or agent labor is excluded.

referenceCommunity.description: A counterfactual community of competent human mathematical researchers collaborating on the canonical BSSC objective, with its program portfolio defined exclusively by the bound Builder V10 knowledge projection.
referenceCommunity.researcherQualification: For each local work package, a researcher with graduate-level mathematical maturity and the information-theory, probability, optimization, or computer-assisted proof expertise needed to begin productive work without general disciplinary training, but without unpublished solution-specific knowledge.
